metaTitle: Custom Towels with Carabiner | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom towels with carabiner for easy attachment. Perfect for golf, gym, or outdoor events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Towels with carabiner clips let your recipients clip them directly to a golf bag, gym duffel, or tool belt—no fumbling for a loop or hook. These branded towels stay accessible through a round of golf or a sweaty workout, making them a practical giveaway that actually gets used. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery on waffle, terry velour, or sport terry fabrics for a polished, durable finish.
heroAltText: Custom towels with carabiner clip attached to a golf bag, featuring embroidered logo and waffle texture
